grades: Apply in 10th grade; programs run grades 11 and 12
pay_detail: Part of your regular school day. No cost stated.
name: Shared-Time Career Programs (grades 11 and 12)
what_you_do: Spend half of each school day in a hands-on shop program in junior and senior year, such as carpentry, electrician, welding, HVAC, auto repair, cosmetology, culinary arts or game programming.
who_can_apply: 10th graders. Applicants are ranked by an acceptance criteria score. The page lists district information sessions, which are not required for admission. Your home district provides transportation.
deadline_text: The 2027-2028 application is open now. No closing date is posted on the page. Info sessions: Oct 29, Nov 19, Dec 9 and Dec 16, 2026 and Jan 11, 2027.
how_to_apply: Create an account in the online application portal and fill in the application. Your school counselor then uploads transcripts and attendance. Email admissions@mcts.edu with questions.
notes: Students in a shared-time program cannot also do Career Prep. Ask your counselor for the deadline. Programs are at the Assunpink Center (Trenton) and the Sypek Center (Pennington).
